findings.text: follow-on: the acceptance score derivation in _score (rebuilt by _rescore at :488) is guarded only by the manual rescore-and-compare-hash procedure; no committed test fails when the derivation or the four-dimension/29-check mix regresses, so a silent change to the score leaves the suite green and the fragment merely stale rather than red.

follow-on: _plot swallows a missing data-ink style with `except OSError: pass`, so a reproduction on a host without the user's stylelib renders default sizing while the fragment declares compliance with the plot-style rules; the committed SVG is compliant (14 in wide, no gridlines) but a re-run elsewhere is not guaranteed to be.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from a55ccd0f6541 to d14927ccd37e; b8b2f1b0d adds the 706-line run.py and d14927ccd adds results.json, the html fragment, the paired-auc.svg and extends run.py (+330/-15) with the rescore, fragment-render and plot stages; no source module and no test file is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the paired AUC of Jev against each of the six incumbent models and the quorum with 95% intervals on validation (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure.html:8-18) and calibration (:20-30), the option-order flip rate and frozen-state variation on 100 names (:32), cost and latency per name (:34), the score derivation (:5), spend under USD 4 (:34) and the shadow verdict under the deployment rule (:41-42), a rescoring pass reproducing every figure at EXIT=0 (rescore-committed.log) and one SVG (paired-auc.svg); all are present and log-backed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to measure the Jev name review against the incumbent quorum over golden A; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure-run.py judges all 720 canonical golden-A names through review_names and decide_batch and derives one acceptance score per name, compared against the six incumbent models and the quorum.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commits b8b2f1b0d and d14927ccd, records the base and head gates (25 passed EXIT=0 each), the rescoring pass EXIT=0 with three identical artifact hashes, and states the landing figures with spend USD 0.151083 of USD 4; its negative_control is correctly declared none, since no test file lies in scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is the fragment html, run.py, results.json and the figures directory docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure; git show --stat over a55ccd0f..d14927ccd names exactly those four paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure-run.py:440 derives the acceptance score and :488 rebuilds the figures from receipts, but no committed test reddens when the derivation or the four-dimension/29-check mix regresses, so the guard is a manual rescore-and-compare-hash procedure rather than an automated failing test.
justifications.evidence: the done_when measure is log-backed at rescore-committed.log (rescore regenerates results.json, the fragment and the SVG from receipts at EXIT=0 with three identical sha256 hashes), and every named figure appears in docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure.html:8-42; the head gate at committed-test.log tests an unmodified module, so it is a regression guard rather than the done_when measure.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure-run.py:440 follows the module's derive-in-code idiom, its module docstring (:1) carries no plan, section or ticket label, and the committed SVG is 1008pt wide with no gridlines; the file names carry the coordinator-assigned node id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-name-review-measure-run.py:88-193 reads the golden-A names and their bounded graph context and :311-437 books one Jev decision per name, so the measure the goal names is what the script performs.
justifications.reuse: the script extends the existing owners rather than forking them — paired_auc, bootstrap_interval, choose_operating_point, option_order_stability, frozen_state_violation-range helpers, judgment.decide_batch and jev_review.review_names/name_question_table are all imported, and a capability search over imas_codex/discovery/base and imas_codex/standard_names/review found no existing owner of a golden-A measurement odometer.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat b8b2f1b0d and d14927ccd names only the four declared paths under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev and docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev, with nothing extra.
